paper_title: Machine Learning Based Resource Allocation for Wireless Communication Systems
methods_models: Machine learning assisted resource allocation with adaptive power optimization
key_parameters: Transmit power, channel quality, SNR, bandwidth, user demand
key_metrics: Throughput, spectral efficiency, energy efficiency, outage probability
best_results: The proposed approach improved resource utilization and achieved better system performance compared with conventional allocation methods.
tools_dataset: Python-based simulation with synthetically generated channel data
limitations: Evaluation was limited to simulated channel conditions and did not include real-world deployment.
research_gap: Future work should validate the approach using real channel measurements and investigate adaptive allocation under rapidly changing environmental conditions.
